head: codex/4650-v0917-release-ceremony
title: [v0.91.7][WP-23] Complete release ceremony (#4650)
body:
Closes #4650

Completes the bounded v0.91.7 WP-23 release ceremony after WP-20 fixed all 22 WP-19 findings.

Highlights:
- Retains human-readable and machine-readable ceremony evidence.
- Reconciles the canonical milestone status surfaces to live WP-20/WP-23 truth.
- Binds the WP-20 typed terminal receipt and labels older tracked records as pre-terminal snapshots.
- Preserves the mandatory reviewed v0.91.8 bridge before v0.92.

Validation:
- Typed PVF passed five required lanes: staged diff, JSON/YAML, local links, protected scope, and C-SDLC doctor.
- Bounded subagent review found five initial findings, three residuals, and one final heading defect; every finding was fixed and the final review returned CLEAN.
- C-SDLC doctor passed at reviewed generation 11.

Non-claims:
- No Git tag or hosted release is created.
- No binary or service is deployed.
- No AWS operation was performed.
- Runtime v3 is not made default, Runtime v2 is not decommissioned, and v0.92 is not activated.
